note: bp_callout is a submodule of bootstrap_paragraphs 5.0.x. It is config-plus-Twig only: no PHP classes, services, plugins, permissions, Drush commands or config schema, and configure=null. Installing it imports paragraphs.paragraphs_type.bp_callout plus five field instances on that bundle: bp_callout_style (list_string, 9 values whose stored value IS the CSS class, callout-style--primary .. callout-style--white), bp_callout_content (entity_reference_revisions -> paragraph, cardinality -1, 13 allowed nested bundles), and the shared bp_header / bp_width / bp_background fields whose storages belong to the parent module. bp_callout.module only implements hook_theme() (paragraph__bp_callout) and hook_help(). Every case below is grounded in that real config: the easy cases ask about the actual allowed values, the real field type and the real nesting settings; the medium cases read back a live Callout paragraph and a live paragraphs field's target_bundles; the hard cases require creating a real paragraphs field that accepts bp_callout, and building a real bp_callout paragraph with specific field values on a node.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site using the bp_callout submodule of Bootstrap Paragraphs, an editor wants a red 'danger' styled callout. What is the machine value stored in the Callout Style field for that, and what does the module do with that stored value?
evals.expected_output: The Callout Style field is bp_callout_style, a list_string with nine allowed values (callout-style--primary, --secondary, --success, --danger, --warning, --info, --dark, --light, --white). Danger is 'callout-style--danger'. The stored value IS the CSS class: paragraph--bp-callout.html.twig matches it against a whitelist and merges it into the wrapper div's class attribute.

evals.prompt: I installed bp_callout on Drupal 11. Can a Callout paragraph contain other Bootstrap Paragraphs bundles inside it? Name the field that does this, its field type, and its cardinality.
evals.expected_output: Yes. The field is bp_callout_content, type entity_reference_revisions targeting paragraph, cardinality -1 (unlimited). Its handler_settings.target_bundles allow 13 bundles (bp_simple, bp_image, bp_blank, bp_accordion, bp_carousel, bp_column_wrapper, bp_columns, bp_columns_three_uneven, bp_columns_two_uneven, bp_block, bp_modal, bp_tabs, bp_view); bp_accordion_section and bp_tab_section are explicitly disabled.

evals.prompt: Where is the admin settings page for the bp_callout module on a Drupal 11 site, and how do I actually make the Callout paragraph type available to editors on a content type?
evals.expected_output: There is none - bp_callout declares no configure route (configure: null) and ships no settings form. The bundle paragraphs.paragraphs_type.bp_callout is imported at install. To use it you add or edit an entity_reference_revisions (Paragraphs) field on a content type and tick the Callout bundle, i.e. add bp_callout to that field's settings.handler_settings.target_bundles.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has an article node titled 'BP Callout Known Notice' that contains a Bootstrap Paragraphs Callout paragraph. Inspect the running site and tell me the exact value stored in that Callout paragraph's Callout Style field.
evals.expected_output: callout-style--info. The node's field_bpcallout_known references a paragraph of bundle bp_callout whose bp_callout_style value is 'callout-style--info' (bp_header is 'Known Callout', bp_width is 'paragraph--width--medium').

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a Paragraphs field called field_bpcallout_probe. Inspect the live configuration and list exactly which paragraph bundles that field is allowed to reference.
evals.expected_output: Exactly two: bp_callout and bp_simple. field.field.node.article.field_bpcallout_probe has settings.handler 'default:paragraph' and settings.handler_settings.target_bundles = {bp_callout: bp_callout, bp_simple: bp_simple}.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, add a Paragraphs field named field_bpcallout_task to the Article content type so editors can place Bootstrap Paragraphs Callout paragraphs on articles. It must be an entity_reference_revisions field targeting paragraphs, allow unlimited values, and be restricted so the bp_callout bundle is among the bundles it accepts. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: node.article gains field_bpcallout_task: a FieldStorageConfig of type entity_reference_revisions with settings.target_type = paragraph and cardinality -1, plus a FieldConfig whose settings.handler is 'default:paragraph' and whose settings.handler_settings.target_bundles contains bp_callout.

evals.prompt: This site already has an Article field called field_bpcallout_build that accepts Bootstrap Paragraphs Callout paragraphs. Create a published article titled exactly 'BP Callout Build Target' and put a Callout in that field. The callout should use the red 'Danger' callout style and its header should read exactly 'Safety Notice'. Save it on the live site.
evals.expected_output: An article node titled 'BP Callout Build Target' whose field_bpcallout_build references a paragraph of bundle bp_callout with bp_callout_style = 'callout-style--danger' (the Danger option) and bp_header = 'Safety Notice'.
